scope: Reversible manual completion of verification checklist items

checks: Click empty circle to complete, click again to reopen
Keyboard Space toggles the focused circle
A real viewer-token HTTP 403 keeps the saved state unchanged and shows an error
Parent verification, coverage, timestamp and human acceptance remain unchanged
Stale plans remain read-only and other tasks are unaffected
Light/dark appearance, 320–1024px layout and no browser errors

nativeDesktop.actualClicks: Empty to filled; quit and reopen; filled state persisted; second click restored empty.

independentReview: No blocking findings in backend or final UI.
limitations: Windows and Ubuntu native operation were not tested in this change
Manual checklist completion does not certify tests or accept the parent task
cloudCI: Not run; remains disabled by user choice.
evidence: Local ignored design/qa/verification-toggle/ contains unit logs, browser summaries and captures, native build and restart checks, and pre-upgrade backups. Private task data and credentials are not committed.
